title: Research Intern - Gray Systems Lab (GSL)
description: Overview Research Internships at Microsoft provide a dynamic environment for research careers with a network of world-class research labs led by globally recognized scientists and engineers. Our researchers and engineers pursue innovation in a range of scientific and technical disciplines to help solve complex challenges in diverse fields, including computing, healthcare, economics, and the environment. Gray Systems Lab (GSL) is an applied research lab within Azure Data . We conduct research and development in databases, big data, and cloud systems, working closely with product teams to design innovative solutions to real-world problems. Our team is friendly and inclusive. We focus on a variety of exciting areas, including: machine learning for systems, reinforcement learning, fine-tuning and post-training techniques, agentic workflows and systems, resource management, query optimization and execution. We also work on workload optimization, graph analytics, data storage formats and governance, modern and emerging hardware (e.g., GPUs, NVM, and FPGAs), program analysis, data provenance, and ontologies. Our work spans both Microsoft internal and open-source systems, including Fabric, Spark, SQL Server, MySQL, Apache Iceberg, and others. We provide opportunities to pursue ideas arising from internal collaborations and external partnerships with universities, while remaining active scholars in the research community. We are looking for highly motivated graduate students interested in cutting-edge research conducted in close collaboration with advanced industry product groups. Past internships have resulted in both production-system impact and publications at top conferences. Applicants should demonstrate a track record in one or more areas of systems, databases, or data science, as well as an aptitude for hands-on system building and rigorous experimental design, including running and analyzing experiments at scale. Contract Length: 12 weeks Location: Barcelona Spain Start Date: June 2027 Responsibilities Turn research questions and theory into practical work during a 12-week research internship. Work with a dedicated mentor throughout the internship. Collaborate with other doctoral interns and leading researchers on research and development projects. Present your research findings to mentors, peers and the wider research community. Take part in the research community and build a professional network. Contribute to research in your area of study while growing your own career. Qualifications Required Qualification Currently pursuing a PhD degree in computer science, statistics, mathematics, or related technical field. Preferred Qualifications Experience with one or more general purpose programming languages, such as Python, Java, C#, C++, Rust. Experience with one of the following: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Spark, Apache Iceberg, CUDA, or other database or big data systems. Experience contributing to research communities and/or efforts, including publishing papers (being listed as author) at academic conferences. Should be able to take initiative but also follow a research/productization plan and work well as part of a team. Excellent critical thinking and communication skills. The base pay for this internship is € 4,000.00 per month. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. Find additional benefits and pay information here: https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/corporate-pay/interns-corporate-pay.html This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. description: Job Details: Job Description: Join Intel's System Level Test (SLT) team within the Technology Development organization as a Mechanical Design and Thermal Engineering Intern . The SLT team develops innovative test platforms and infrastructure that enable validation and high-volume manufacturing of Intel's leading-edge products. In this role, you will collaborate with experienced engineers to design, analyze, and optimize mechanical and thermal solutions for complex test hardware and systems. You will contribute to the development of next-generation test platforms by supporting concept development, CAD design, thermal analysis, prototyping, laboratory validation, and system integration activities. As a Mechanical Design and Thermal Engineering Intern, you will gain hands-on experience solving real-world engineering challenges related to structural design, cooling technologies, reliability, manufacturability, and system performance. You will help characterize and resolve mechanical and thermal issues through experimentation, data analysis, and engineering simulations while working closely with cross-functional teams across mechanical, thermal, electrical, manufacturing, and system engineering disciplines. This position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to technologies that directly impact Intel's product development and manufacturing success while building technical expertise in mechanical design, thermal management, and semiconductor test systems. Key Responsibilities Designs and develops mechanical devices, systems, equipment, and packaging, creating practical mechanical designs that incorporate design for manufacture, design for serviceability, and design for sustainability considerations. Develops system concepts from scratch, creates product and test specification based on requirements, drives system integration, development, procurement, acceptance, and deployment to high volume manufacturing. Creates mechanical customer guidance for appropriate use of the designs and resolves customer concerns. Defines and conducts feasibility studies and develops and implements test plans and parameters for new and existing mechanical designs, including functionality validation, reliability, and safety. Lists the mechanical properties of the designed products or parts within a product and validates unique mechanical and/or thermomechanical solutions and equipment. Applies deep materials knowledge and mechanical expertise to select right materials, components, and manufacturing technologies for the system. Coordinates with suppliers to incorporate manufacturing feedback, produce the designs, and resolve manufacturing issues. Conducts design reviews and performs system acceptance tests working with customers, drives structural and stress analysis of the key mechanical components such as the chassis structure, heat sinks, and thermal attachment, prototypes testing, initiates design improvement, and resolves design and implementation issues. Performs Mechanical Simulation Engineering tasks, including creating mechanical finite-element model geometry and meshing with parametric scripting, developing material models from measured material characterization, executing and post-processing simulation static or transient solutions that accounts for system boundary conditions, manufacturing process steps, and reliability stress conditions. Mechanical simulation structures can scale from silicon, packaging, PCBs, device system to multiple systems. Executes tolerance analysis from component level to board and system level. Collaborates with thermal engineers, electromechanical engineers, industrial designers, and other system engineers to optimize the design parameters, deliver performance objectives, and partner with external vendors through initial conceptual studies, layout, design, fabrication, assembly, debugging, and validation. Experience listed above should be in any the following: Proficiency in 3D modeling and AutoCAD. Knowledge of design for manufacturing (DFM) principles. Understanding of mechanical design fundamentals and hardware design. Understanding of reliability and thermal principles in mechanical systems. Ability to innovate and adapt mechanical designs for diverse applications. description: At IBM Infrastructure & Technology, we design and operate the systems that keep the world running. From high-resiliency mainframes and hybrid cloud platforms to networking, automation, and site reliability. Our teams ensure the performance, security, and scalability that clients and industries depend on every day. Working in Infrastructure & Technology means tackling complex challenges with curiosity and collaboration. You'll work with diverse technologies and colleagues worldwide to deliver resilient, future-ready solutions that power innovation. With continuous learning, career growth, and a supportive culture, IBM provides the opportunities to build expertise and shape the infrastructure that drives progress. Technical content is the backbone of our client's digital self-service experience and is essential for client retention and growth. As we strive for great user experiences, we need great technical content professionals building those experiences. What is an Apprenticeship? IBM Apprenticeship Program, which lasts approximately 12 months, is an official registered apprenticeship recognized by the Department of Labor (DOL). Every graduate of a Registered Apprenticeship program receives a nationally-recognized credential from the DOL. During the apprenticeship duration, you will be required to complete specific learning hours and on the job training that has been outlined to ensure you are developing the skills and competencies essential to the role. You will be able to learn and grow at your own pace, but we expect most apprentices will complete their learning within 12 months. Once you graduate and receive your certificate from our apprentice program, you will be eligible to apply to available full-time roles at IBM. Who you Are An apprenticeship is about learning. We’re seeking candidates who have the following requirements, but we know you’re just getting your career started, and we’re committed to helping you learn and grow. If you’ve had some experience with coding or development and creating some form of technical content in the past, you’re exactly the type of candidate we’re looking for…. Drive and eagerness to learn Strong problem solving and communication skills Able to work independently and take initiative, as well as work collaboratively and contribute to an agile team environment Some knowledge or experience in ONE or more of the following: Ability to write accurate, clear, and concise content for a global audience. Ability to Design, develop, edit, and produce accurate and effective technical documentation. Design Thinking Ability to use and contribute to shared source repositories such as GitHub Agile principles Experience with HTML, XML or DITA tagging languages Ability to understand technical concepts and write accurate, clear, and concise content. Willingness to complete the requirements of the apprenticeship program.
